assumptions.choice: Bypass sector and market volatility filters
assumptions.reason: The execution environment provides only single-asset OHLCV data (AAPL) without sector metadata or a market-wide index feed. AAPL is assumed to satisfy both the technology sector and volatility filter requirements.

assumptions.choice: Calculate share quantity as int((total_equity * 0.02) / current_close)
assumptions.reason: The specification dictates position size as 2% of total trading capital per trade.

assumptions.choice: Close position when bar close is strictly below the current 10-day EMA
assumptions.reason: Condition 1 under Exiting explicitly states 'Close the position if price closes below the 10-day EMA'.

assumptions.choice: Trigger market close order when bar high reaches or exceeds 10% above entry price
assumptions.reason: Condition 2 under Exiting specifies closing upon reaching 10% profit from the entry price.
